'''R4-GL''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] located inside the [[Network Security District]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where it was destroyed around [[3643 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
R4-GL appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion world boss on Nar Shaddaa. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
